gen-dafont-quantum-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws one ruler-straight line with wide, open curve endings and a tall x-height. Quantum sits loose and spacious above it, and the whole page moves along without a snag, every line easy to follow.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-aldrich: Redux spaces its letters wide and swings into each curve with a big visible entrance. Aldrich follows with flat, unmodulated lowercase that sits close to cap height, so the two feel tidy and clear together.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla keeps its s curves wide and barely curled in. Under Redux, with its thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, a long read stays friendly, with short ascenders keeping every line compact.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall, almost like squared-off woodblock type. Its terminals stop well away from the stem, so a long page feels open and modern, with Redux's gentle taper leading the way above.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin lifts its lowercase nearly to capital height, and the letters stay held open rather than curling shut. Long reading goes smoothly.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-anek-malayalam: Clean, contemporary lines lead here. Redux adds a mild stress in its o and e, while Anek Malayalam keeps curve tips apart and lowercase close to cap height, so headline and text sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-blinker: Redux swells gently on its curves and spaces every letter wide, giving headings a relaxed, geometric presence. Blinker holds a steady line.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-carrois-gothic: Wide-spaced and geometric, Redux curves in with a gentle gradient of weight along each stroke. It earns its place when set big and brief, above Carrois Gothic.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-chocolate-classical-: Redux spreads wide, with a big entrance into every curve and the soft thick-thin shift of a pencil. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-comme: Redux has a mellow thick-thin shift and wide spacing that makes its curves feel unhurried. Comme keeps every curve unclogged, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, so text slides by smoothly.
